apps.name: Golden Hour
apps.subject: photography / astronomy
apps.one_liner: Live sun tracker that counts down to today's golden hour and blue hour for your exact spot.

apps.name: Drift
apps.subject: focus / ambient sound
apps.one_liner: Ambient focus mixer - rain, thunder, wind, fire and waves, all synthesized live in your browser, with a sleep-timer fade-out.

apps.name: Flag Rush
apps.subject: geography / trivia
apps.one_liner: The 60-second flag quiz - name as many world flags as you can, streaks multiply your score.

apps.name: Pixel Forge
apps.subject: art / creativity
apps.one_liner: A pocket pixel art studio - pencil, fill, mirror mode, 32-color palette, and crisp PNG export, all in the browser.

apps.name: Chord Wheel
apps.subject: music theory
apps.one_liner: An interactive circle of fifths you can hear - pick a key, play its diatonic chords, and build progressions.

apps.name: Orbit Lab
apps.subject: physics / space
apps.one_liner: A real gravity sandbox - drag to launch a satellite and find the velocity that closes a stable orbit.

apps.name: Type Sprint
apps.subject: typing / skill
apps.one_liner: A typing speed test with live WPM and accuracy, 30/60s modes, and a chart of your last 10 runs.

apps.name: Neon Snake
apps.subject: retro games
apps.one_liner: The classic snake game with a neon glow - keyboard or swipe, rising speed, saved high score.

apps.name: Pulse
apps.subject: fitness
apps.one_liner: A HIIT interval timer with work/rest/rounds, Tabata presets, audio cues, and a color-coded screen.

apps.name: Pantry Raid
apps.subject: cooking / recipes
apps.one_liner: Tick the ingredients you have and get recipes ranked by what you can cook right now, with exactly what's missing.

apps.name: Compound
apps.subject: finance / investing
apps.one_liner: An interactive compound-interest visualizer: deposits vs interest stacked year by year, with the numbers behind the snowball.

apps.name: Mate in One
apps.subject: chess / puzzles
apps.one_liner: 12 chess positions, each mate in one move, judged by a real built-in chess engine - any move that mates counts.

apps.name: Bike or Bus?
apps.subject: weather
apps.one_liner: Live weather for any city turned into one 0-100 bike score, with every deduction itemized and a 6-hour outlook.

apps.name: Word Bridge
apps.subject: language / word games
apps.one_liner: The classic word ladder: one letter per step, every step a real word, 16 BFS-verified bridges with par scores and live hints.

apps.name: Make 24
apps.subject: math / arithmetic
apps.one_liner: Four numbers, four operations, each used once - hit exactly 24. Every hand solver-verified, streaks included.

apps.name: Memory Matrix
apps.subject: memory / brain training
apps.one_liner: Tiles flash on a grid, you rebuild the pattern from memory. Growing grids, 3 lives, best level saved.
